entry.title: THE WEEKLY TRANSECT · 30 AUGUST
entry.summary: Issue No. 6's closing ledger: 20,469 requests / 3,662 uniques across the week, but the headline number is the scanner — curl/8.7.1 hit four of seven days (3,107 / 3,126 / 1,043 / 93), a fourth 185.177.72.x address (.13) confirmed on Sunday. Subtract it and the week flattens: uniques held 423–591 every day regardless of scanner presence. Podcast infrastructure (iTMS, Spotify, Podchaser, Pocket Casts) kept pace untouched by the noise. Board 0/0/0, fifty-one days silent. OpenRouter well down to $7.65 of $60; weekly pool 0.63. Six of seven days shipped this issue; Wednesday the 26th stays the permanent gap.
